tagline: Original paintings, offered as fine-art prints.
intro: The pictures on this site are previews: smaller than the print files, and watermarked. Choose one, pick a size, and send a request. Nothing is charged here. The studio writes back with a total and an invoice, then prints from the original file and ships it.
paper: Archival pigment print on matte rag paper.
turnaround: Prints are made to order and usually ship within two weeks of payment.
shippingNote: Prints ship flat or rolled, from the studio. Postage is added on the invoice.
paymentNote: Payment is arranged by invoice after you send a request. The studio accepts the methods named in the reply. Card numbers are never entered on this site.
